WITH order_counts AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as account_orders
  FROM "order"
  GROUP BY account_id
),
total_orders AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total
  FROM "order"
),
account_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    oc.account_id,
    oc.account_orders,
    CAST(oc.account_orders AS REAL) / t.total as share
  FROM order_counts oc
  CROSS JOIN total_orders t
),
average_share_overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM account_shares
),
above_average_accounts AS (
  SELECT 
    ashr.account_id,
    ashr.account_orders,
    ashr.share,
    ashr.share - avg.avg_share as distance_above
  FROM account_shares ashr
  CROSS JOIN average_share_overall avg
  WHERE ashr.share > avg.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(account_orders) as total_orders,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(distance_above) as average_distance_above
FROM above_average_accounts;

assumptions.assumption: Only accounts that appear in the order table (have at least one order) are considered when calculating shares and the average share. Accounts in the account table with zero orders are excluded from analysis.

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate share for every account in the account table, treating missing orders as 0/total = 0 for accounts not in the order table. Then filter for accounts above the overall average share and aggregate.

WITH order_counts AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as account_orders
  FROM "order"
  GROUP BY account_id
),
total_orders AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total
  FROM "order"
),
all_accounts_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    COALESCE(oc.account_orders, 0) as account_orders,
    CAST(COALESCE(oc.account_orders, 0) AS REAL) / t.total as share
  FROM account a
  CROSS JOIN total_orders t
  LEFT JOIN order_counts oc ON a.account_id = oc.account_id
),
average_share_overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM all_accounts_shares
),
above_average_accounts AS (
  SELECT 
    ashr.account_id,
    ashr.account_orders,
    ashr.share,
    ashr.share - avg.avg_share as distance_above
  FROM all_accounts_shares ashr
  CROSS JOIN average_share_overall avg
  WHERE ashr.share > avg.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(account_orders) as total_orders,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(distance_above) as average_distance_above
FROM above_average_accounts;
